display.purpose: Page and landing headlines with a condensed Archivo setting.

measurement.purpose: Coordinates, metadata, status, time, and aligned trading values.

shadows.name: overlay-only
shadows.purpose: Reserve library shadows for dialogs, menus, and drawers that overlap content.

motion.name: section-enter
motion.purpose: One clipped, lightly blurred reveal for the entering working section.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The rare survey-orange action used for the next decisive step.
components.css: .ds-primary { height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; background: oklch(0.704 0.175 43); color: oklch(0.16 0.032 238); font: 600 14px/1.25 Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.67 0.15 249); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Sheet
components.description: A square working region registered to the 24px construction grid.
components.css: .ds-section { border: 1px solid oklch(0.68 0.06 237 / 24%); border-radius: 0; background-color: oklch(0.195 0.035 238 / 55%); background-image: linear-gradient(to right, oklch(0.68 0.06 237 / 11%) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, oklch(0.68 0.06 237 / 11%) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 24px 24px; }

narrative.overview: JotTrade treats each trade as a section drawing. Setup, execution, result, and lesson align to a shared datum on cool vellum or deep blueprint grounds.

rules.name: The Survey Mark Rule
rules.body: Orange marks the next decisive action. Passive surfaces never borrow it.

rules.name: The Measurement Voice Rule
rules.body: Azeret Mono belongs to values, coordinates, status, and alignment labels.

rules.name: The Drawn Structure Rule
rules.body: Use alignment, hairlines, and tonal changes before adding elevation.

dos: Align evidence to shared construction lines.
Keep orange rare and cobalt structural.
Use open ledgers for comparison-heavy information.
donts: Do not rebuild pages as equal rounded cards.
Do not use gradients, glass effects, or decorative glow.
Do not use market colors for decoration.
